창세기 1~11장(원역사)에 기록된 4대 핵심 사건의 올바른 순서는?: What is the correct order of the four key events recorded in Genesis 1~11 (primeval history)?
창조 - 타락 - 바벨탑 - 홍수 심판: Creation - Fall - Tower of Babel - Flood judgment
창조 - 타락 - 홍수 심판 - 바벨탑 분산: Creation - Fall - Flood judgment - Scattering at Babel
창조 - 홍수 심판 - 타락 - 바벨탑: Creation - Flood judgment - Fall - Tower of Babel
타락 - 창조 - 홍수 심판 - 바벨탑: Fall - Creation - Flood judgment - Tower of Babel
창세기 1~11장은 원역사로서 ①천지만물과 인간 창조(1-2장), ②인간: Genesis 1~11, the primeval history, unfolds in this order: ① the creation of all things and of man (ch. 1-2), ② man's sin and fall (ch. 3-5), ③ the judgment of Noah's flood (ch. 6-10), ④ the Tower of Babel and the scattering of mankind (ch. 11).
하나님께서 아브라함에게 고향, 친척, 아비 집을 떠나라고 명하시며 주신: When God commanded Abraham to leave his country, his relatives, and his father's house, what was the ultimate promise He gave him (Gen 12:3)?
온 세상의 절대 군주가 되어 부귀영화를 누리는 것: To become the absolute ruler of the whole world and enjoy wealth and glory
모든 전쟁에서 무패의 장군이 되는 것: To become a general who never loses a single war
땅과 큰 민족을 이루고 '땅의 모든 족속이 너로 말미암아 복을 얻는 것': To become a great nation in a land, and 'that all the families of the earth be blessed through you'
영원히 육체적으로 죽지 않는 불로불사를 얻는 것: To gain eternal youth and never die physically
창세기 12장 1-3절에서 하나님은 아브라함 개인이나 한 가문의 기복이: In Genesis 12:1-3, God did not give Abraham a mere blessing for himself or his family. He gave him a priestly mission as a channel of salvation for all peoples: 'You will be a blessing... in you all the families of the earth will be blessed.'
에덴동산 중앙에 하나님께서 선악과(선악을 알게 하는 나무)를 두신 본질적: What was the essential purpose of God placing the fruit of the knowledge of good and evil (the tree of the knowledge of good and evil) in the middle of the Garden of Eden?
인간을 함정에 빠뜨려 벌주기 위한 덫: A trap to lure man into a snare and punish him
사람이 결코 하나님이 아니며, 참된 주인이신 하나님을 기억하게 하는 '피: A 'boundary stone marking the creature's limits' that reminds man he is never God, and that God is the true Master
선악과 열매의 독성을 시험해보기 위한 생물학적 시험: A biological test to check whether the fruit was poisonous
천사들에게만 먹이기 위해 아껴둔 천상의 특별 과일: A special heavenly fruit saved to be eaten only by angels
노우호 목사님의 성경강좌에서는 선악과를 '피조물의 한계 표지판'으로 설명: Pastor Woo-ho Noh's Bible course explains the forbidden fruit as 'a signpost of the creature's limits.' Man could enjoy everything in Eden, yet remember that God, the real Master, is there, and stay under His authority. It was a holy spiritual safeguard.
아브라함이 모리아 산에서 독자 이삭을 번제로 드리려 할 때, 하나님께서: When Abraham was about to offer his only son Isaac as a burnt offering on Mount Moriah, God provided a ram in his place. What is the confession of faith that names this event?
창세기 22장 14절에서 아브라함은 '여호와의 산에서 준비되리라' 하여: In Genesis 22:14, Abraham called the name of that place 'Jehovah Jireh,' saying, 'On the LORD's mountain, it will be provided.' This foreshadows God's redemption, in which He would one day provide His only Son Jesus at Golgotha.
야곱이 얍복 나루에서 하나님의 사자와 밤새 씨름한 후 얻게 된 새로운 이: After wrestling all night with the angel of God at the ford of the Jabbok, Jacob received the new name 'Israel.' What does it mean?
하나님과 및 사람들과 겨루어 이김: One who struggled with God and with men and prevailed
발꿈치를 잡은 교활한 자: A cunning one who grabbed the heel
사막의 거대한 사자: A mighty lion of the desert
하늘의 별처럼 찬란한 자: One as radiant as the stars of heaven
창세기 32장 28절: '그가 이르되 네 이름을 다시는 야곱이라 부를 것: Genesis 32:28: 'He said, "Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed."'
형들에게 팔려 애굽의 총리가 된 요셉이 자신을 판 형들을 용서하며 고백한: Joseph was sold by his brothers and became prime minister of Egypt. When he forgave the brothers who sold him, he confessed his faith in God's providence (Gen 50:20). What was the heart of it?
내가 반드시 권력으로 형들에게 복수하겠나이다: I will surely take revenge on you, my brothers, with my power
당신들은 나를 해하려 하였으나 하나님은 그것을 선으로 바꾸사 많은 백성의: You meant to harm me, but God turned it to good, to save the lives of many people
우연히 운이 좋아 총리가 되었으니 형들도 한자리씩 차지하시오: I became prime minister by sheer luck, so you brothers can each take a post too
과거는 다 잊었으니 이제 애굽 신들을 섬깁시다: The past is all forgotten, so now let us serve the gods of Egypt
창세기 50장 20절: '당신들은 나를 해하려 하였으나 하나님은 그것을: Genesis 50:20: 'You meant to harm me, but God turned it to good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.' This is the peak of Joseph's faith: he forgave his enemies and trusted God's great plan of salvation.
창세기 3장 15절에서 여자의 후손이 뱀의 머리를 상하게 할 것이라고 최: In Genesis 3:15, the promise of salvation was proclaimed for the first time: the offspring of the woman would crush the serpent's head. What is this promise called?
창세기 3장 15절은 인류 타락 직후 하나님께서 사탄의 권세를 멸하시고: Genesis 3:15 is the word in which, right after mankind's fall, God first announced the Messiah who would destroy Satan's power and save mankind (the virgin birth and the victory of the cross). Theology calls it the 'Proto-gospel.'
출애굽기 19장 5-6절에 나타난 시내산 언약의 핵심으로서, 하나님의 백: As the heart of the Sinai covenant in Exodus 19:5-6, what is the purpose for which God's people exist?
황금과 무역을 독점하는 부유한 나라: A rich nation that monopolizes gold and trade
세상과 완전히 담을 쌓고 은둔하는 폐쇄적 민족: A closed people who wall themselves off from the world and live in seclusion
시내산 언약의 정수는 '너희가 내 말을 잘 듣고 내 언약을 지키면 너희는: The essence of the Sinai covenant is this word: 'If you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you will be my own possession from among all peoples... and you will be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.'
애굽의 10대 재앙 중 마지막 재앙이자 유월절(Passover) 제정의: Which of the ten plagues of Egypt was the last one, and the occasion for establishing the Passover?
장자(초태생)의 죽음 재앙: The plague of the death of the firstborn
출애굽기 12장에서 하나님은 애굽의 모든 처음 난 자를 치셨으나, 흠 없: In Exodus 12, God struck all the firstborn of Egypt, but He passed over the Israelite homes that had put the blood of a spotless lamb on the doorposts and lintel (Pass-over, the Passover).
하나님께서 모세에게 성막(회막)을 지으라고 명하신 가장 근본적인 이유(출: What was the most basic reason God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle (the tent of meeting) (Exod 25:8)?
주변 이방 나라들에게 성전 건축 기술을 과시하기 위해: To show off temple-building skills to the surrounding nations
내가 그들 중에 거할(함께 살) 성소를 짓게 하려 함: To have a sanctuary built so that I may dwell (live together) among them
백성들의 금과 은을 거두어 국가 재정을 비축하기 위해: To collect the people's gold and silver and build up the national treasury
광야의 모래바람을 피하기 위한 대형 피난 텐트: To provide a large shelter tent against the desert sandstorms
출애굽기 25장 8절: '내가 그들 중에 거할 성소를 그들이 나를 위하여: Exodus 25:8: 'Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.' The tabernacle expresses Immanuel love: the holy God Himself pitches His tent in the very middle of His sinful people and lives with them.
성막 건축을 위해 성령의 충만함과 지혜를 받아 정교한 금·은·놋 기구를: Who were the two master craftsmen who, filled with the Spirit and wisdom, made the fine gold, silver, and bronze furnishings for building the tabernacle?
출애굽기 31장 1-6절에서 하나님은 유다 지파 '브살렐'과 단 지파 ': In Exodus 31:1-6, God called by name 'Bezalel' of the tribe of Judah and 'Oholiab' of the tribe of Dan, filled them with the Spirit, and had them make the furnishings of the tabernacle.
십계명 중 '인간과 하나님 사이의 관계'를 다루는 제1계명부터 제4계명에: Of the Ten Commandments, the first to fourth deal with 'the relationship between man and God.' Which of these is NOT among them?
너는 나 외에는 다른 신들을 네게 두지 말라: Thou shalt have no other gods before me
너를 위하여 새긴 우상을 만들지 말라: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image
네 부모를 공경하라: Honour thy father and thy mother
안식일을 기억하여 거룩하게 지키라: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy
십계명 중 1~4계명은 하나님과의 관계를, 5~10계명은 인간 상호 간의: Of the Ten Commandments, the 1st to 4th deal with our relationship with God, and the 5th to 10th with our relationships with one another. 'Honour thy father and thy mother' is the 5th commandment, the first of the commandments about human relationships.
모세가 시내산에서 40일 금식하며 십계명 돌판을 받는 동안, 산 아래에서: While Moses fasted 40 days on Mount Sinai and received the stone tablets of the Ten Commandments, what rebellious idolatry did Aaron and the people commit at the foot of the mountain?
몰렉에게 자녀 번제: Offering children as burnt offerings to Molech
출애굽기 32장에서 백성들은 눈에 보이는 신을 요구하며 금고리를 모아 금: In Exodus 32, the people demanded a god they could see. They gathered gold earrings, made a golden calf, and danced wildly, saying, 'This is your god, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.'
레위기 11장 45절과 19장 2절에 반복되는 레위기 전체의 핵심 주제: What key verse, repeated in Leviticus 11:45 and 19:2, states the main theme of the whole book of Leviticus?
오직 정의를 물 같이, 공의를 마르지 않는 강 같이 흐르게 할지어다: Let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream
내가 거룩하니 너희도 거룩할지어다: Ye shall be holy: for I am holy
믿음, 소망, 사랑 이 세 가지는 항상 있을 것인데: And now abide faith, hope, love, these three
내 백성을 가게 하라 그들이 나를 섬길 것이니라: Let my people go, that they may serve me
레위기는 거룩하신 하나님과 언약 백성이 동행하기 위한 규례를 담고 있으며: Leviticus contains the rules by which the covenant people can walk with the holy God. Its key motto is 'Ye shall be holy: for I am holy.'
레위기 1~7장에 기록된 이스라엘의 5대 제사에 해당하지 않는 것은?: Which of these is NOT one of Israel's five offerings recorded in Leviticus 1~7?
레위기의 5대 기본 제사는 번제(Olah), 소제(Minchah), 화목: The five basic offerings of Leviticus are the burnt offering (Olah), grain offering (Minchah), peace offering (Shelamim), sin offering (Chattat), and guilt offering (Asham). Firstfruits is the name of a feast.
레위기 16장에서 일 년에 단 한 번 대제사장이 피를 가지고 지성소에 들: In Leviticus 16, on which day did the high priest, once a year only, enter the Most Holy Place with blood to make atonement for the sins of all Israel?
7월 10일 대속죄일(Yom Kippur)에 대제사장은 피를 들고 지성소: On the Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur), the 10th day of the 7th month, the high priest carried blood into the Most Holy Place and sprinkled it on the mercy seat. He laid hands on the head of the goat for Azazel, putting the people's sins on it, and sent it away into the wilderness.
레위기 17장 11절에서 성경이 피를 먹지 말라고 명하시며 피의 제사를: In Leviticus 17:11, the Bible forbids eating blood and brings about atonement through blood sacrifice. What is the basic principle behind this?
육체의 생명이 피에 있으므로 피가 죄를 속하기 때문에: Because the life of the flesh is in the blood, and the blood makes atonement for sin
피를 보면 공격성이 높아지기 때문에: Because seeing blood makes people more aggressive
고대 보건 위생상 세균 감염을 막기 위해서만: Only to prevent bacterial infection, for ancient hygiene
레위기 17장 11절: '육체의 생명은 피에 있음이라 내가 이 피를 너희: Leviticus 17:11: 'For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.'
7년마다 땅을 쉬게 하는 안식년이 7번 지난 후, 제50년째에 모든 빚을: The land was given rest every 7th year (the sabbath year). After seven of these, in the 50th year, all debts were canceled, land returned to its original owner, and slaves set free. What is this year called?
레위기 25장에 기록된 희년(히브리어 요벨)은 제50년째 되는 해로, 하: The Jubilee (Hebrew 'yobel') recorded in Leviticus 25 was the 50th year. It was a holy social gospel system that forbade permanent ownership of God's land and gave restoration and freedom to the poor.
민수기(Numbers)라는 책 이름은 백성의 수를 계수한 데서 유래했습니: The book name Numbers comes from the counting of the people. How many censuses are recorded in Numbers?
민수기에는 시내산 출발 직전 출애굽 1세대 장정 계수(1장, 603,55: Numbers contains two censuses in all: the count of fighting men of the first Exodus generation just before leaving Mount Sinai (ch. 1, 603,550 men), and the count of the second generation on the plains of Moab after 40 years in the wilderness (ch. 26, 601,730 men).
가데스 바네아에서 가나안 땅을 정탐하고 돌아온 12명의 정탐꾼 중 오직: Of the 12 spies who explored the land of Canaan and returned to Kadesh Barnea, who were the only two who gave a positive report of faith?
10명의 정탐꾼은 '우리는 메뚜기 같다'며 원망했으나, 여호수아와 갈렙은: The 10 spies complained, 'We are like grasshoppers,' but Joshua and Caleb boldly declared, 'If the LORD delights in us, that land is our bread' (Num 14).
광야 길에서 불평하다 불뱀에 물려 죽어가던 백성들이 모세가 장대 끝에 매: On the wilderness road, people who grumbled were bitten by fiery serpents and were dying. They lived when they looked at this thing that Moses hung on top of a pole. What was it?
민수기 21장의 놋뱀 사건은 요한복음 3장 14절에서 예수님께서 친히 인: Jesus Himself quoted the bronze serpent event of Numbers 21 in John 3:14. It foreshadowed that whoever looks to Christ lifted up on the cross and believes will have eternal life.
모압 왕 발락이 이스라엘을 저주해 달라고 뇌물을 주고 불렀으나, 하나님의: Balak king of Moab paid a bribe and summoned a foreign prophet to curse Israel. But seized by the Spirit of God, he poured out blessings instead of curses. Who was he?
민수기 22~24장에 나오는 발람(Balaam)은 나귀의 입이 열리는 책: Balaam in Numbers 22~24 was rebuked when his donkey's mouth was opened, yet he kept acting out of greed. In the end, compelled by God, he blessed Israel.
신명기 6장 4-5절의 유대인 신앙의 최고 강령인 '쉐마(Shema)'의: What is the first line of the 'Shema,' the highest creed of Jewish faith, in Deuteronomy 6:4-5?
태초에 하나님이 천지를 창조하시니라: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth
이스라엘아 들으라 우리 하나님 여호와는 오직 유일한 여호와이시니: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD
너희는 가만히 있어 내가 하나님 됨을 알지어다: Be still, and know that I am God
여호와는 나의 목자시니 내게 부족함이 없으리로다: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want
히브리어로 '들으라'는 뜻의 '쉐마(Shema)'는 '이스라엘아 들으라: The 'Shema,' meaning 'Hear!' in Hebrew, is the command: 'Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.'
신명기(申命記) 책 이름의 한자 '신(申)'의 바른 뜻은?: In the Korean name of Deuteronomy, 신명기 (申命記), what is the correct meaning of the Chinese character 'sin (申)'?
거듭 신 (申) - 말씀을 되풀이하여 간절히 당부함: 'Sin' meaning again (申) - repeating the word and earnestly urging it
신명기의 '신'은 거듭 신(申)으로, 모세가 모압 평지에서 광야에서 태어: The 'sin' of 신명기 is 申, 'again.' It means that on the plains of Moab, Moses taught and urged the next generation, born in the wilderness (the second Exodus generation), by earnestly repeating the spirit of the Sinai law once more.
신명기 28장에 나오는 말씀에 대한 순종과 불순종의 극명한 대비는 무엇인: What is the stark contrast concerning obedience and disobedience to the word in Deuteronomy 28?
순종의 축복과 불순종의 저주: Blessing for obedience and curse for disobedience
신명기 28장은 '네가 네 하나님 여호와의 말씀을 청종하면 들어가도 복을: Deuteronomy 28 proclaims the two-edged sword of the covenant: 'If you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, you will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out... if you disobey, you will be cursed.'
모세가 120세의 나이로 가나안 땅을 바라보며 생을 마감한 산의 이름은?: What is the name of the mountain where Moses, at the age of 120, looked out over the land of Canaan and ended his life?
신명기 34장 1-5절에서 모세는 느보산 비스가산 꼭대기에서 약속의 땅을: In Deuteronomy 34:1-5, Moses looked out over the whole promised land from the top of Pisgah on Mount Nebo and then went into God's arms. God Himself buried him.
이스라엘이 가나안 땅으로 건너갈 때 언약궤를 멘 제사장들의 발이 물에 닿: When Israel crossed into the land of Canaan, the water stopped as soon as the feet of the priests carrying the ark of the covenant touched it, and the people crossed as on dry ground. Which river was it?
여호수아 3장에서 모내기 철에 물이 언덕까지 넘치던 요단강은 제사장들의: In Joshua 3, in the planting season, the Jordan was overflowing up to its banks. Yet it stopped as the priests stepped forward in faith.
여리고 성을 점령할 때 이스라엘 백성들이 하나님의 명령대로 행한 승리의: When taking the city of Jericho, how did the people of Israel win by following God's command?
철제 사다리와 투석기로 성벽을 부숨: Broke down the walls with iron ladders and catapults
6일 동안 매일 성을 한 바퀴 돌고, 7일째에 일곱 바퀴 돌며 나팔을 불: Marched around the city once a day for 6 days, and on the 7th day marched around seven times, blew trumpets, and shouted loudly
